caption: AI Operation
description: AI-specific attributes for model operations, retrieval systems, and agent activities. e.g. model_name, total_token_counts etc.
name: ai_operation

ai_agent.description: The autonomous AI agent that performed this operation. Carries model identity via ai_agent.ai_model. Populate when the action was performed by an agent rather than a direct model call.

ai_model.description: The AI model involved in this operation. Use for direct model invocations where no autonomous agent is involved. For agent-mediated operations, model identity is carried within ai_agent.ai_model instead.

delegation.description: The delegation under whose authority this AI operation was performed. Links the event to a durable authorization context independent of traces and sessions, enabling correlation of all events executed under the same delegated authority.

stop_reason.caption: AI Stop Reason
stop_reason.description: The reason the model completion ended, normalized to the caption of the stop_reason_id value. In the case of 'Other', it is the event source's native label, e.g. end_turn or max_tokens.

stop_reason_id.caption: AI Stop Reason ID
stop_reason_id.description: The normalized reason the model completion ended - not the reason the event's own subject stopped. Producers map their runtime's native value into this set. Populate on completion events; when the value is 'Other', set stop_reason to the event source's native label. Because completion behavior is bound to the configuration that produced it, a shift in this attribute's distribution is more meaningful when weighed against that configuration: ai_model.version for direct model invocations, and ai_agent.version, ai_agent.charter, and ai_agent.instance_uid for agent-mediated operations.

0.caption: Unknown
0.description: The completion ended without the producer being able to determine why, so the state of the operation at termination is not established.

1.caption: End of Turn
1.description: The model reached the end of its turn: it completed its response naturally or emitted a configured stop sequence, and is not waiting on anything further.

2.caption: Token Limit
2.description: The completion was truncated by a token or length limit before the model finished, so the response is incomplete.

3.caption: Tool Use
3.description: The completion paused to invoke a tool. The turn is not finished; the model expects the tool result and will continue.

4.caption: Session Stop
4.description: The completion ended because the session or connection carrying it terminated - for example the caller cancelled, the client disconnected, or the transport closed - rather than because the model reached a stopping point. The session state at termination is therefore known, which distinguishes this from Unknown and lets a consumer decide whether the operation needs investigation or can simply be reclaimed.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The stop reason is not mapped. See the stop_reason attribute, which contains the event source's value.
